entities.name: Silas Duskmoor
entities.description: Exhibits extroverted authority, loud dominance, savage humor, and fights like a storm.
entities.quote: Silas = extroverted authority, loud dominance, savage humor, sometimes “acts dumb” on purpose, fights like a storm with big explosive movement.

entities.name: Agnus
entities.description: Exhibits introverted authority, silent finality, and fights with minimal movement.
entities.quote: Agnus = introverted authority, silent finality, speaks selectively (especially only with Silas), fights with minimal movement, precise execution energy.

entities.name: Tedmond
entities.description: Presence helped force Diablo to retreat during the Diablo War.
entities.quote: Tedmond’s presence + kid-Dorian’s “madness” aura + Norman’s fearlessness forced Diablo to retreat.

entities.name: Diablo
entities.description: Ancient demon incursion leader who led an incursion alongside a Prince of Demons.
entities.quote: Ancient demon incursion led by Diablo (Right Hand of the Devil) and a Prince of Demons.

entities.name: Soa Aldercrest
entities.description: Suffered a stolen childhood due to Aldercrest desperation and died by suicide.
entities.quote: Aldercrest desperation pressured Soa Aldercrest (Athena’s Judgement host) → childhood stolen → suicide → Dorian’s ideological fracture.

entities.name: Dorian Cross
entities.description: Experienced an ideological fracture after Soa's suicide and joined Nullborn.
entities.quote: Dorian joins Nullborn because he learns: “Greater good” can kill innocents even without villains.

entities.name: Eldrich Aldercrest
entities.description: Became half-demonic and vanished after Dorian's death and Khalid's revenge, presumed dead.
entities.quote: After Dorian’s death and Khalid’s revenge, Eldrich becomes half-demonic and vanishes; presumed dead.

entities.name: Elizabeth Pristine
entities.description: A shapeshifting girl aligned with Khalid who stages events to break Liam and Norman's trust.
entities.quote: A shapeshifting girl aligned with Khalid, Elizabeth Pristine, stages events to break Liam–Norman trust.

entities.name: Norman
entities.description: Framed as a killer by Elizabeth Pristine, becoming Norman the Paleborne.
entities.quote: She frames Norman as the killer, fakes “saving” him, and pushes him into the point-of-no-return.

entities.name: Liam
entities.description: Trusted companion whose bond with Norman was broken by Elizabeth Pristine.
entities.quote: stages events to break Liam–Norman trust.

entities.name: Ethan Thorne
entities.description: Has an outside name of Robin or Bunny.
entities.quote: Ethan Thorne (outside name: Robin/Bunny), Elizah (outside name: Robi).

entities.name: Elizah
entities.description: Has an outside name of Robi.

entities.name: Zayn Hayes
entities.quote: Zayn Hayes, Altan El-Mansur (Agnus), Silas Duskmoor, Eldrich Aldercrest, Dorian Cross, etc.

entities.name: Duskmoor
entities.description: Bloodline beginning when spirits raised the child of a hybrid and a weak female spirit.
entities.quote: Spirits raised that child → Duskmoor bloodline begins.

entities.name: Nullborn
entities.description: An organization joined by Dorian Cross after realizing the greater good can kill innocents.
entities.quote: Dorian joins Nullborn because he learns: “Greater good” can kill innocents even without villains.

entities.name: Al-Ahd
entities.description: Listed as part of the clan anchors.
entities.quote: Clan anchors include Al-Ahd, Duskmoor, Eldercrest, El-Mansur, and demonic-clan line threads.

entities.name: Eldercrest
entities.description: Listed as part of the clan anchors.
entities.quote: Clan anchors include Al-Ahd, Duskmoor, Eldercrest, El-Mansur, and demonic-clan line threads.

entities.description: Listed as part of the clan anchors.

timeline_events.title: Diablo War
timeline_events.description: Ancient demon incursion led by Diablo and a Prince of Demons, which was forced to retreat.
timeline_events.quote: Ancient demon incursion led by Diablo (Right Hand of the Devil) and a Prince of Demons. Tedmond’s presence + kid-Dorian’s “madness” aura + Norman’s fearlessness forced Diablo to retreat.
